d:
India’s Inflation number has historically been around 6-4%, but it never feels this way. Almost everywhere we feel the numbers are high!
And to answer why, we need to understand.
How is inflation calculated?
And since these numbers don’t reflect the inflation we feel, it is important to understand.
How does this number affect our life and our portfolio?
How can we calculate the ‘right’ inflation for us
And most importantly
How can we make sure to beat this ‘right’ number!
